subject: Sarah Chen
text: Former Synthetic AI Labs engineer Sarah Chen has left the company and is building a new inference infrastructure project. The project is currently in stealth.

subject: Marcus Webb
text: Integral Family Office names Marcus Webb Partner with a new venture allocation mandate. His official bio now adds responsibility for the office's venture fund allocation and emerging manager program.

subject: Ada Lin
text: Foundry Robotics, founded by Ada Lin, has raised a $28M Series A led by an unnamed fund to scale its manipulation hardware.

subject: Ben Ortiz
text: Cobalt Analytics, where Ben Ortiz was head of product, has been acquired by a larger data platform.
